title: Etch 2 chamber pressure fault
briefing: You're covering Bay 3 (litho, etch and deposition). Walk the bay, keep the tools running and respond to anything unusual. Your operator terminal (Tab) shows tool status and incoming wafer lots.

timeline.speaker: Supervisor
timeline.text: Morning! You're covering Bay 3 today. Take a walk down the aisle and get familiar with the tools. Your terminal is on Tab.

timeline.speaker: Supervisor
timeline.text: Heads up, I'm seeing an alarm on Etch 2 from here. Can you check it out?

reset_resume:ETCH-02.message: Chamber B pressure high, wafer in process scrapped

reset_resume:ETCH-02.speaker: Supervisor
reset_resume:ETCH-02.text: Etch 2 alarmed again? Did someone reset it? We just lost a wafer.

emo.speaker: Supervisor
emo.text: Was that an EMO? That kills power to the whole tool and scraps what's in the chambers. EMO is for emergencies only.

call_maintenance:ETCH-02.speaker: Maintenance
call_maintenance:ETCH-02.text: Maintenance here. Got your ticket for Etch 2, we're on our way.

notify_supervisor.speaker: Supervisor
notify_supervisor.text: Got it, thanks for the update.

lot_arrived:ETCH-02.speaker: Supervisor
lot_arrived:ETCH-02.text: LOT-4471 just landed on Etch 2 while it's alarmed. Those wafers are stuck there now.

lot_arrived:ETCH-03.speaker: Supervisor
lot_arrived:ETCH-03.text: Why is LOT-4471 sitting at Etch 3? That tool is down for maintenance.

expect.label: Acknowledged the alarm at the tool
Rerouted LOT-4471 to the working etcher (ETCH-01)

order.label: Put the tool on hold before checking what was wrong
Called maintenance before reading the alarm details

forbid.label: Pressed the emergency stop (EMO) when nobody was in danger
Reset the alarm and resumed processing without maintenance
Sent the lot to a tool that is down for maintenance (ETCH-03)
Let LOT-4471 be delivered to the faulted tool
Put a healthy tool on hold

say.speaker: Supervisor
say.text: Nice work. Etch 2 is safe and maintenance has it from here. That's the end of this exercise.
